statements.statement: The patient presents with exertional dyspnea and palpitations
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring (CPT 93247) was ordered
The service was to evaluate for paroxysmal arrhythmias contributing to the symptoms
The denial reason was that required precertification or authorization was not obtained prior to the date of service
